metadata.description: Small, calibrated, local decision models: skills, MCP tools and a PreToolUse guard for Claude Code.

plugins.name: jev-style
plugins.description: Skills (serve, use, eval, adopt, guard, mcp) and MCP tools (decide, noul, choice, score) for the local Jev-Style decision model. Needs `jev-style serve` running.

plugins.name: jev-style-guard
plugins.description: PreToolUse hook: the local Jev-Style model checks Bash/Write/Edit/Read/WebFetch/MCP calls and answers allow / ask / deny. Fails safe to ask.
